rcc-institute-of-information-technology.description: RCC Institute of Information Technology is an engineering college at Beliaghata, Kolkata, run by a society formed by the Government of West Bengal.
rcc-institute-of-information-technology.about: RCCIIT was set up in 1999 through a collaboration between the Regional Computer Centre, Calcutta, of the National Informatics Centre and the Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal. It is run by the RCC Institute of Technology society formed by the state government. It holds a NAAC B++ grade with a CGPA of 2.94, valid from 2022 to 2027.
rcc-institute-of-information-technology.address: Canal South Road, Beliaghata, Kolkata, West Bengal 700015

seacom-engineering-college.description: Seacom Engineering College is a private engineering college at Jaladhulagori near Andul in the Sankrail area of Howrah district.
seacom-engineering-college.about: The college is part of the Seacom group of institutions. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. It offers B.Tech programmes including computer science specialisations in AI and machine learning, and IoT with cyber security.
seacom-engineering-college.address: JL Jaladhulagori (via Andul Mouri), Sankrail, District Howrah, West Bengal 711302
seacom-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

st-thomas-college-of-engineering-and-tec.description: St. Thomas' College of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college on Diamond Harbour Road in Kidderpore, Kolkata.
st-thomas-college-of-engineering-and-tec.about: STCET came into being on 29 August 2000. It is approved by AICTE. Its computer science, information technology, electronics and communication, and electrical engineering departments are NBA accredited.
st-thomas-college-of-engineering-and-tec.address: 4 Diamond Harbour Road, Kidderpore, Kolkata, West Bengal 700023

techno-bengal-institute-of-technology.description: Techno Bengal Institute of Technology, formerly Bengal Institute of Technology, is a Techno India Group engineering college on Basanti Highway, Kolkata.
techno-bengal-institute-of-technology.about: The college was established in 2000 as Bengal Institute of Technology with four AICTE-approved courses. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly WBUT). It currently runs four undergraduate courses and one postgraduate course.
techno-bengal-institute-of-technology.address: Tech Town, Basanti Highway, No. 1 Govt. Colony, Kolkata, West Bengal 700150
techno-bengal-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

techno-international-new-town.description: Techno International New Town, formerly Techno India College of Technology, is a Techno India Group engineering college in New Town, Kolkata.
techno-international-new-town.about: TINT was established in 2005 under the Techno India Group and was earlier known as Techno India College of Technology. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. It holds a NAAC B++ grade from its first cycle and offers a wide range of B.Tech, M.Tech, BBA, BCA, MBA and MCA programmes.
techno-international-new-town.address: Block DG 1/1, Action Area 1, New Town, Kolkata, West Bengal 700156
techno-international-new-town.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

techno-main-salt-lake.description: Techno Main Salt Lake is a Techno India Group engineering college in Sector V, Salt Lake, the IT hub of Kolkata.
techno-main-salt-lake.about: The institute was established in 2001. It sits in Sector V of Salt Lake, Kolkata. It runs more than fifteen undergraduate programmes along with several postgraduate courses in engineering, management and computer applications.
techno-main-salt-lake.address: EM-4/1, Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal 700091

university-college-of-science-and-techno.description: University College of Science and Technology is the University of Calcutta's science and technology college at the Rajabazar Science College campus in Kolkata.
university-college-of-science-and-techno.about: The college is located at the Rajabazar Science College campus on Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road. The foundation stone of the Science College was laid by Sir Asutosh Mookerjee on 27 March 1914. The campus offers B.Tech programmes including chemical engineering, chemical technology, polymer science and technology, radio physics and electronics, information technology, instrumentation and electrical engineering.
university-college-of-science-and-techno.address: 92 Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road, Kolkata, West Bengal 700009

university-college-of-science-and-techno.description: University College of Science and Technology is the University of Calcutta's science and technology college at the Rajabazar Science College campus in Kolkata.
university-college-of-science-and-techno.about: The college is located at the Rajabazar Science College campus on Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road. The foundation stone of the Science College was laid by Sir Asutosh Mookerjee on 27 March 1914. The campus offers B.Tech programmes including chemical engineering, chemical technology, polymer science and technology, radio physics and electronics, information technology, instrumentation and electrical engineering.
university-college-of-science-and-techno.address: 92 Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road, Kolkata, West Bengal 700009

university-of-engineering-and-management.description: University of Engineering and Management, Kolkata is a private university in New Town, Kolkata, founded and run by the IEM group.
university-of-engineering-and-management.about: UEM Kolkata was established in 2014 by West Bengal Act No. 25 of 2014. It is founded and managed by the IEM group, which set up the Institute of Engineering and Management in 1989. Its campus is in New Town Action Area III, close to the Kolkata airport. B.Tech admission is through WBJEE or JEE Main counselling or the group's own IEMJEE test.
university-of-engineering-and-management.address: University Area, Plot No. III-B/5, Main Arterial Road, New Town Action Area III, Kolkata, West Bengal 700160

ghani-khan-choudhury-institute-of-engine.description: Ghani Khan Choudhury Institute of Engineering and Technology is a centrally funded technical institute at Narayanpur in Malda district, offering diploma and B.Tech programmes.
ghani-khan-choudhury-institute-of-engine.about: GKCIET started functioning in 2010 at Narayanpur, Malda. It is a centrally funded institute under the Ministry of Education and admits B.Tech students through JoSAA. Its departments include computer science, mechanical engineering, and food engineering and technology.
ghani-khan-choudhury-institute-of-engine.address: PO Narayanpur, Dist Malda, West Bengal 732141
